K-th Smallest Signal in Range

You are monitoring seismic data arriving through an array of N sensors, each outputting a reading. You receive Q queries of the form l r k, asking: among the sensor readings in the contiguous range [l, r] (1-indexed), what is the k-th smallest value?

Queries must be answered efficiently without sorting each subarray independently.
explanation: This is solved using a Persistent Segment Tree. First, coordinate-compress the values to ranks [1..M]. Then build a Persistent Segment Tree indexed by value rank, where we insert elements one by one (creating a new version for each prefix). Each tree version counts how many elements with value rank ≤ v have been inserted so far. For a query [l, r, k], we use version r and version l-1, subtracting prefix counts to simulate a range-indexed segment tree. Binary search on the rank to find the k-th smallest.
